## Why visit

A handsome glazed-tile pub that makes the Oxford Road cluster more than a two-stop excursion. The traditional exterior, tucked-away snug and riverside balcony give it individual character, and the guest cask range provides a reason to step inside. It works especially well as an additional stop around the Salisbury and Peveril rather than a standalone cross-city expedition. November’s university-term atmosphere should be considered when choosing a time; the room can have a different energy from a quiet heritage visit.

## Beer

CAMRA lists a house cask bitter plus four changing cask beers from local, regional and national brewers.

## Plan the visit

A student-friendly working pub with sport and quizzes. Choose timing according to whether you want conversation or a lively session.

**Getting there:** Walk from Manchester Oxford Road; combine with Salisbury Ale House and Peveril of the Peak.
